perksWithImages.name: Flip-Flop
perksWithImages.description: While downed, whenever the Killer picks you up, {Tunable.S17P01.RecoveryRatio%}% of your recovery progress is added to your wiggle progress, up to {Tunable.S17P01.MaxWiggle%}%.

perksWithImages.name: Hex: Face the Darkness
perksWithImages.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

Every {Tunable.K30P02.ScreamInterval}s, other Survivors not within your Terror Radius scream, then you see their Auras for {Tunable.K30P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

When the hexed Survivor is downed or becomes healthy, the Hex Totem is extinguished.

perksWithImages.name: Monitor & Abuse
perksWithImages.description:
While chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K07P02.TerrorRadiusIncrease%}% bigger.

While not chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K07P02.TerrorRadiusDecrease%}% smaller.

perksWithImages.name: Come and Get Me!
perksWithImages.description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor, while crouched and idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to have injured and downed Survivors within {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDistance}m:
  • Make no Grunts of Pain for {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDuration}s.
  • Leave no Pools of Blood for {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDuration}s.
  • Leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDuration}s.


You scream, then the Killer sees your Aura for {Tunable.S47P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.
